[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Vreen''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for [[Bioniip Laboratories/Legends|Bioniip Laboratories]] before being hired by Doctor [[Issan Len]] to work on the prototype [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[X0-X1]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Death">In [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] entry in ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 54]]'', the murder of Issan Len in ''[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|Crisis on Cloud City]]'' is mentioned to have occurred before [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9's]] rampage through [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. That even was referred to in [[Idiot's Array/Legends|''Idiot's Array'']], which was stated to have taken place in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> he attempted to sell the droid to [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
